Service rules
General rules
Betwave is a free platform where you can create
and share sports Predictions.
Key terms and concepts:
Prediction — a virtual bet on a sporting event
published on the service and containing the
author’s opinion on the match outcome.
Predictor — any registered Betwave user who
creates Predictions.
General platform rules:
All Predictions are settled according to 1win
rules. Odds, payout and refund conditions, as
well as the details of individual markets, follow
the platform’s General Rules and Conditions. If a
Prediction includes bets on events that are
cancelled, postponed, or do not take place,
those bets will be settled at odds of 1.0.
Top predictors contest rules
This is a monthly competition for Predictors.
Winners are determined by the
highest ROI
(Return on Investment)
achieved from the
Predictions*. You can see your ROI in the
Profit
tab
in your Betwave profile. To participate,
publish 5 Predictions. There are no extra
requirements or restrictions.
ROI (Return on Investment)
is a measure of
betting performance. It is calculated by dividing
your profit by the total amount wagered and
multiplying the result by 100%. For example, if
you place bets totaling 1,000 vUSD and earn 150
vUSD in profit, your ROI is
. This means that
the size of your balance is not what matters most—it's
the accuracy of your Predictions
Results are summed up on the
last day of each
calendar month
. Only settled bets are counted
— pending bets do not affect the results. Cash
prizes are awarded to the 20 Predictors with the
highest ROI. The prize pool is distributed as
follows.
Place
Prize
Place
Prize
Total
Participants must follow the service rules and
fair play principles. Fraud, multiple accounts, or
other violations may lead to account blocking.
Blocked users will not be able to continue
participating in the competition or receive prizes.
Requirements for Predictions and Fair Play
Only independent predictions count toward the
minimum participation requirement.
The following will NOT be counted toward the
minimum number of predictions:
Posting multiple identical predictions for the
same event and outcome.
Reposting the same prediction to satisfy the
minimum participation requirement.
Mass posting of identical or substantially
similar predictions.
Any actions intended to artificially satisfy the
participation requirements or obtain an unfair
competitive advantage.
The Organizer reserves the right to treat multiple
identical predictions as a single prediction or
exclude them from the competition results.
If abuse of the competition mechanics is
detected, including spam, automated posting,
duplicate predictions, or any other attempt to
circumvent the rules, the Organizer reserves the
right to disqualify the participant and void their
results without awarding prizes.
* Starting June 9, 2026, winners are determined by ROI
instead of profit.
Top Predictors
has been updated to
reflect the new rules.
Prediction creation rules
You can post Predictions only for Pre-match
events. Live events are not available for creating
Predictions.
A Prediction can consist of single or multiple
bets. The maximum number of events in a
Prediction is 3.
The minimum bet amount is 1% of your Betwave
virtual balance. The maximum bet amount is
10%. You can create an unlimited number of
Predictions, even for the same event. Once a
Prediction is posted, it cannot be edited or
deleted.
The Prediction description must not contain
profanity, random strings of numbers, symbols,
letters, or words. You cannot publish images,
videos, or audio, and writing in Caps Lock is not
allowed. Make sure your Prediction does not
contain links or any advertising. Repeated
violations may result in your account being
banned.
